promptEn: Write about your job or your studies. How long have you done it? Use for and since.
promptAr: اكتب عن عملك أو دراستك. منذ متى تقوم به؟ استخدم for و since.
modelAnswer: I am a civil engineer. I have worked for a water company since 2019, so I have been there for more than five years. I have learned a lot about pipe networks. I have also lived in the same city since I was a child.
selfCheckAr: هل استخدمت for مع المدة و since مع نقطة البداية؟
هل استخدمت have أو has مع التصريف الثالث؟

promptEn: Write a short message after a meeting. Say what you discussed, and ask a colleague to explain one point to you.
promptAr: اكتب رسالة قصيرة بعد اجتماع. اذكر ما ناقشتموه، واطلب من زميل أن يشرح لك نقطة واحدة.
modelAnswer:
Dear team,
Thank you for today's meeting. We discussed the new schedule and the budget for the second phase. Sara, could you please explain the new cost table to me? I did not understand the last column.
Best regards,
Yousef
selfCheckAr: هل كتبت explain ... to me، وليس explain me؟

promptEn: Describe your workplace. Use there is and there are.
promptAr: صف مكان عملك. استخدم there is و there are.
modelAnswer: Our office is on the third floor. There is a large meeting room near the entrance. There are ten desks in the main area, and there is a small kitchen at the end of the corridor. There are no windows in the store room.
selfCheckAr: هل استخدمت There is مع المفرد و There are مع الجمع؟
هل تجنبت حذف is و are؟
هل ذكرت أين يوجد كل شيء؟

promptEn: Write about your work habits. Use always, usually, often and never in the right place.
promptAr: اكتب عن عاداتك في العمل. ضع always و usually و often و never في المكان الصحيح.
modelAnswer: I usually arrive at the office at half past seven. I always check my email first. I often visit the site on Tuesdays. I never send a report before my manager reviews it. I enjoy my work very much.
selfCheckAr: هل وضعت ظروف التكرار قبل الفعل الأساسي؟
هل وضعت very much في آخر الجملة؟
هل جاء المفعول بعد الفعل مباشرة؟

promptEn: Write about your plans for next week. Use going to and will.
promptAr: اكتب عن خططك للأسبوع القادم. استخدم going to و will.
modelAnswer: Next week, I am going to visit the new pump station. On Monday, we are going to test the main valves. I think the test will take two days. After that, I will write a short report for the client.
selfCheckAr: هل استخدمت going to للخطط المقررة؟
هل جاء الفعل بعد will دون to ودون s؟

titleEn: A building or bridge in your city
promptEn: Describe a building or a bridge in your city. Use the passive, for example was built and is used.
promptAr: صف مبنى أو جسرًا في مدينتك. استخدم المبني للمجهول، مثل was built و is used.
modelAnswer: The main bridge in our city was built in 1998. It was designed by a local company. Today it is used by thousands of cars every day. It was repaired in 2020, and new lights were installed.
selfCheckAr: هل وضعت was أو is قبل التصريف الثالث؟
هل كتبت التصريف الثالث بشكل صحيح؟
